description: Занятое население по видам экономической деятельности, 2001-2019 (Taldau)
methodology: Labour force survey, Taldau 702840 on the ОКЭД-2 (dictionary 915) segment, which stops in 2019; 2010-2019 equal EMPLOYED_BY_SECTION (within 0.1 thousand) except S: element 5831 folds T and U into S, Taldau keeps them apart (T to 2014, U 2012-2015; S+T+U = 5831's S every year). Adds 2001-2009. Break in 2014 (agriculture 2 074 → 1 605 thousand, survey reweighting).
